name: meeting-recorder
description: A Claude Code skill + three small Linux commands: record any call locally (mic + system audio as separate channels, no bot), transcribe it on-device with whisper.cpp (GPU via Vulkan when available, speaker labels, silence skipping), then let Claude write a summary in the language spoken, propose a CRM entry (Airtable) or a Google Doc in the right Drive folder, and share it read-only with the attendees only after two explicit confirmations. Profiles keep work and personal meetings apart. Audio never leaves the machine.
